name: evir-research
description: Evidence and tools for Evir's Rive compatibility research

scripts.research: npm run generate && npm test && npm run validate && npm run validate:webgl2 && npm run benchmark && npm run benchmark:webgl2 && npm run report
scripts.research:advanced: npm run generate:advanced && npm test && npm run test:geometry && npm run validate:advanced && npm run validate:advanced:webgl2 && npm run vector:lab
scripts.research:complex: npm run generate:advanced && npm run generate:complex && npm test && npm run test:geometry && npm run validate:complex && npm run validate:complex:webgl2 && npm run probe:feather
scripts.research:closure: npm run generate:closure && npm test && npm run validate:closure && npm run validate:closure:webgl2 && npm run test:device-runner && npm run benchmark:closure && npm run benchmark:closure:webgl2
scripts.research:all: npm run research && npm run research:advanced && npm run research:complex && npm run research:closure && npm run research:editor-export && npm run report:closure
scripts.research:editor-export: python3 tools/inspect_editor_export.py && node tools/validate_editor_export.cjs && RIVE_RENDERER=webgl2 node tools/validate_editor_export.cjs
scripts.test:editor: node --test tests/editor/*.test.mjs && node tests/editor/browser.cjs && node tests/editor/authoring-browser.cjs
